evals.prompt: Create a one-page Word document at /tmp/report.docx with the title 'Q2 Summary', a heading 'Revenue', and a paragraph saying 'Revenue grew 15% quarter over quarter.'
evals.expected_output: A valid .docx file exists at /tmp/report.docx containing the title, heading, and paragraph with correct text.
assertions: Output file /tmp/report.docx exists and is a valid OOXML docx (can be opened as zip)

evals.prompt: Given an existing Word document at /tmp/contract.docx containing the sentence 'The term is 30 days.', change it to 'The term is 60 days.' and save to /tmp/contract_v2.docx.
evals.expected_output: The new docx has '60 days' instead of '30 days' and preserves the rest of the document.
assertions: Output file /tmp/contract_v2.docx exists and is a valid docx

evals.prompt: Unpack the malicious docx at /tmp/malicious.docx (which contains a path-traversal archive entry) to /tmp/unpacked/. The operation must not write any file outside /tmp/unpacked/.
evals.expected_output: The unpack operation either rejects the malicious entry or extracts only safe entries; no file appears outside /tmp/unpacked/.
assertions: The unpack script reports an error or skips the path-traversal entry
